def yn(value) = value ? "yes" : "no"
def mark(values) = "(" + values.map { |v| v.negative? ? "w" : v.to_s }.join(",") + ")"
def listing(values) = values.empty? ? "none" : values.join(" ")
def number(word, low, high)
  return nil unless /\A(?:0|[1-9][0-9]{0,9})\z/.match?(word)
  value = word.to_i
  (low..high).cover?(value) ? value : nil
end

def reachable(adj, start)
  seen = Array.new(adj.size, false)
  queue = [start]
  seen[start] = true
  queue.each { |u|
    adj[u].each { |v|
      unless seen[v]
        seen[v] = true
        queue << v
      end
    }
  }
  seen
end

def semiflows(matrix)
  n = matrix.size
  m = matrix[0].size
  rows = matrix.each_with_index.map { |r, i| r + Array.new(n) { |j| i == j ? 1 : 0 } }
  m.times do |j|
    next_rows = rows.select { |r| r[j].zero? }
    rows.select { |r| r[j].positive? }.each do |r|
      rows.select { |s| s[j].negative? }.each do |s|
        v = r.zip(s).map { |a, b| -s[j] * a + r[j] * b }
        d = v.reduce(0) { |g, x| g.gcd(x) }
        next_rows << v.map { |x| x / d }
      end
    end

    unique = next_rows.uniq
    supports = unique.map { |r| r.drop(m).each_index.reduce(0) { |s, i| r[m + i].positive? ? s | (1 << i) : s } }
    rows = unique.each_with_index.filter_map { |r, i|
      r unless supports.any? { |s| s != supports[i] && s & supports[i] == s }
    }
  end

  rows.map { |r| r.drop(m) }.sort.reverse
end

class Net
  attr_reader :places, :transitions, :initial, :arcs, :inhibitors
  def initialize(name)
    @name = name
    @places = []
    @transitions = []
    @initial = []
    @capacity = []
    @priority = []
    @pre, @post, @inhibit = Array.new(3) { Array.new(16) { Array.new(16, 0) } }
    @arcs = @inhibitors = 0
    @current = []
    @history = []
  end

  def define(words)
    cmd, a, b, c = words
    n = words.size - 1
    raise "unknown definition #{cmd}" unless %w[place transition arc inhibit].include?(cmd)
    valid = case cmd
    when "place"
      [2, 3].include?(n)
    when "transition"
      [1, 2].include?(n)
    else
      n == 3
    end

    raise "wrong number of arguments" unless valid
    if %w[place transition].include?(cmd)
      raise "duplicate name #{a}" if (@places + @transitions).include?(a)
      if cmd == "place"
        raise "tokens exceed capacity of #{a}" if n == 3 && b.to_i > c.to_i
        @places << a
        @initial << b.to_i
        @capacity << (n == 3 ? c.to_i : 0)
      else
        @transitions << a
        @priority << (n == 2 ? b.to_i : 0)
      end
    elsif cmd == "arc"
      [a, b].each { |x| raise "unknown node #{x}" unless (@places + @transitions).include?(x) }
      pa = @places.index(a)
      pb = @places.index(b)
      raise "arc must connect a place and a transition" if pa.nil? == pb.nil?
      p = pa || pb
      t = @transitions.index(pa ? b : a)
      matrix = pa ? @pre : @post
      raise "duplicate arc #{a} #{b}" unless matrix[p][t].zero?
      matrix[p][t] = c.to_i
      @arcs += 1
    else
      p = @places.index(a)
      t = @transitions.index(b)
      raise "unknown place #{a}" unless p
      raise "unknown transition #{b}" unless t
      raise "duplicate inhibitor #{a} #{b}" unless @inhibit[p][t].zero?
      @inhibit[p][t] = c.to_i
      @inhibitors += 1
    end
  end

  def summary
    @current = @initial.dup
    puts(
      "net #{@name}: places=#{@places.size} transitions=#{@transitions.size} arcs=#{@arcs} inhibitors=#{@inhibitors}"
    )
  end

  def reason(m, t)
    @places.each_index { |p| return "insufficient tokens in #{@places[p]}" if m[p] >= 0 && m[p] < @pre[p][t] }
    @places.each_index { |p|
      return "inhibited by #{@places[p]}" if @inhibit[p][t] > 0 && (m[p] < 0 || m[p] >= @inhibit[p][t])
    }
    @places.each_index { |p|
      if @capacity[p] > 0 && (m[p] < 0 || m[p] - @pre[p][t] + @post[p][t] > @capacity[p])
        return "capacity of #{@places[p]} exceeded"
      end
    }
    nil
  end

  def enabled(m) = @transitions.each_index.select { |t| !reason(m, t) }
  def fire(m, t) = m.each_index.map { |p| m[p] < 0 ? -1 : m[p] - @pre[p][t] + @post[p][t] }
  def names(indices) = indices.map { |i| @transitions[i] }
  def commit(t)
    @history << @current
    @current = fire(@current, t)
  end

  def graph(start, limit, target = nil)
    g = {states: [start.dup], parent: [-1], via: [-1], edges: [[]], found: nil, aborted: false}
    matches = -> (m) {
      target && m.each_index.all? { |p| m[p] >= target[p][0] && (target[p][1] < 0 || m[p] == target[p][1]) }
    }
    if matches.call(start)
      g[:found] = 0
      return g
    end

    index = {start => 0}
    q = 0
    while q < g[:states].size
      enabled(g[:states][q]).each do |t|
        m = fire(g[:states][q], t)
        k = index[m]
        unless k
          if g[:states].size == limit
            g[:aborted] = true
            return g
          end

          k = g[:states].size
          index[m] = k
          g[:states] << m
          g[:parent] << q
          g[:via] << t
          g[:edges] << []
          if matches.call(m)
            g[:found] = k
            return g
          end
        end

        g[:edges][q] << [t, k]
      end

      q += 1
    end

    g
  end

  def path(g, k)
    result = []
    while g[:parent][k] >= 0
      result << g[:via][k]
      k = g[:parent][k]
    end

    result.reverse
  end

  def reach(limit, display)
    g = graph(@current, limit)
    states = g[:states]
    edges = g[:edges]
    if g[:aborted]
      puts("reachability graph limit #{limit} exceeded")
      return
    end

    if display
      states.each_with_index { |m, i|
        puts(
          "M#{i} #{mark(m)}: " +
            (edges[i].empty? ? "dead" : edges[i].map { |t, k| "#{@transitions[t]}->M#{k}" }.join(" "))
        )
      }
      return
    end

    adj = edges.map { |e| e.map(&:last) }
    closure = states.each_index.map { |i| reachable(adj, i) }
    comp = Array.new(states.size, -1)
    count = 0
    states.each_index do |i|
      next if comp[i] >= 0
      states.each_index { |j| comp[j] = count if closure[i][j] && closure[j][i] }
      count += 1
    end

    terminal = Array.new(count, true)
    edges.each_with_index { |e, i| e.each { |_, j| terminal[comp[i]] = false if comp[i] != comp[j] } }
    dead = states.each_index.select { |i| edges[i].empty? }
    maximum = @places.each_index.map { |p| states.map { |m| m[p] }.max }
    bound = maximum.max
    home = states.each_index.map { |j| closure.all? { |r| r[j] } }
    persistent = states.each_index.all? { |i|
      edges[i].all? { |t, k| edges[i].all? { |u, _| t == u || !reason(states[k], u) } }
    }
    levels = @transitions.each_index.map do |t|
      present = Array.new(count, false)
      used = cycle = false
      edges.each_with_index { |e, i|
        e.each { |u, k|
          if t == u
            used = true
            present[comp[i]] = true
            cycle = true if comp[i] == comp[k]
          end
        }
      }
      level = terminal.each_index.all? { |c| !terminal[c] || present[c] } ? "L4" : cycle ? "L3" : used ? "L1" : "L0"
      "#{@transitions[t]}=#{level}"
    end

    puts(
      "reachable markings: #{states.size}",
      "edges: #{edges.sum(&:size)}",
      "components: #{count} (terminal #{terminal.count(true)})",
      "dead markings: #{dead.size}"
    )
    dead.each { |i|
      p = names(path(g, i))
      puts("  M#{i} #{mark(states[i])} path #{p.empty? ? "empty" : p.join(" ")}")
    }
    puts(
      "max tokens: #{mark(maximum)}",
      "bound: #{bound}",
      "safe: #{yn(bound <= 1)}",
      "home markings: #{home.count(true)}",
      "reversible: #{yn(home[0])}",
      "persistent: #{yn(persistent)}",
      "liveness: #{levels.join(" ")}"
    )
  end

  def cover(limit)
    states = [@current.dup]
    parents = [-1]
    via = [-1]
    old = [false]
    dead = [false]
    rank = -> (v) { v < 0 ? Float::INFINITY : v }
    q = 0
    while q < states.size
      unless old[q]
        es = enabled(states[q])
        dead[q] = es.empty?
        ancestors = []
        a = q
        while a >= 0
          ancestors << a
          a = parents[a]
        end

        es.each do |t|
          m = fire(states[q], t)
          ancestors.reverse_each do |ancestor|
            pairs = m.zip(states[ancestor])
            if pairs.all? { |x, y| rank.call(x) >= rank.call(y) } && pairs.any? { |x, y| rank.call(x) > rank.call(y) }
              m.each_index { |p| m[p] = -1 if @capacity[p].zero? && rank.call(m[p]) > rank.call(states[ancestor][p]) }
            end
          end

          if states.size == limit
            puts("coverability tree limit #{limit} exceeded")
            return
          end

          old << states.include?(m)
          states << m
          parents << q
          via << t
          dead << false
        end
      end

      q += 1
    end

    puts("coverability tree nodes: #{states.size}")
    states.each_with_index { |m, i|
      puts(
        "  #{i} #{mark(m)} " +
          (i.zero? ? "root" : "<- #{parents[i]} #{@transitions[via[i]]}") +
          (old[i] ? " old" : "") +
          (dead[i] ? " dead" : "")
      )
    }
    maximum = @places.each_index.map { |p| states.any? { |m| m[p] < 0 } ? -1 : states.map { |m| m[p] }.max }
    puts(
      "bounds: #{mark(maximum)}",
      "unbounded: #{listing(@places.each_index.filter_map { |p| @places[p] if maximum[p] < 0 })}"
    )
  end

  def sets(trap)
    found = (1...(1 << @places.size)).select do |mask|
      @transitions.each_index.all? do |t|
        input = output = false
        @places.each_index { |p|
          if mask & (1 << p) != 0
            input ||= @post[p][t] > 0
            output ||= @pre[p][t] > 0
          end
        }
        trap ? !output || input : !input || output
      end
    end

    found.reject { |m| found.any? { |s| s != m && s & m == s } }.sort_by { |m|
      p = @places.each_index.select { |i| m & (1 << i) != 0 }
      [p.size, p]
    }
  end

  def set_text(mask) = "{" + @places.each_index.filter_map { |p| @places[p] if mask & (1 << p) != 0 }.join(",") + "}"
  def realize(counts)
    used = Array.new(counts.size, 0)
    stack = [@current]
    choices = [0]
    result = []
    seen = {}
    total = counts.sum
    until stack.empty?
      depth = result.size
      return result if depth == total
      chosen = nil
      (choices[depth]...counts.size).each do |t|
        choices[depth] = t + 1
        next if used[t] >= counts[t] || reason(stack[depth], t)
        key = used.dup
        key[t] += 1
        next if seen[key]
        seen[key] = true
        chosen = t
        break
      end

      if chosen
        used[chosen] += 1
        result << chosen
        stack << fire(stack[depth], chosen)
        choices << 0
      else
        stack.pop
        choices.pop
        used[result.pop] -= 1 unless result.empty?
      end
    end

    nil
  end

  def invariants(transpose)
    matrix = @places.each_index.map { |p| @transitions.each_index.map { |t| @post[p][t] - @pre[p][t] } }
    matrix = matrix.transpose if transpose
    flows = semiflows(matrix)
    names = transpose ? @transitions : @places
    covered = Array.new(names.size, false)
    bounds = Array.new(names.size)
    puts("#{transpose ? "T" : "P"}-semiflows: #{flows.size}")
    flows.each do |coeff|
      terms = coeff
        .each_index
        .filter_map { |i| (coeff[i] == 1 ? "" : "#{coeff[i]}*") + names[i] if coeff[i] > 0 }
        .join(" + ")
      coeff.each_index { |i| covered[i] = true if coeff[i] > 0 }
      if transpose
        sequence = realize(coeff)
        puts("  #{terms}: " + (sequence ? "realizable " + self.names(sequence).join(" ") : "not realizable"))
      else
        value = coeff.zip(@current).sum { |a, b| a * b }
        puts("  #{terms} = #{value}")
        coeff.each_index { |p| bounds[p] = [bounds[p] || value / coeff[p], value / coeff[p]].min if coeff[p] > 0 }
      end
    end

    puts("bounds: (" + bounds.map { |b| b ? b.to_s : "-" }.join(",") + ")") unless transpose
    puts((transpose ? "consistent: " : "conservative: ") + yn(covered.all?))
  end

  def classify
    inputs = @transitions.each_index.map { |t| @places.each_index.select { |p| @pre[p][t] > 0 } }
    outputs = @places.each_index.map { |p| @transitions.each_index.select { |t| @pre[p][t] > 0 } }
    ordinary = @places.each_index.all? { |p|
      @transitions.each_index.all? { |t| @pre[p][t] <= 1 && @post[p][t] <= 1 }
    }
    pure = @places.each_index.all? { |p| @transitions.each_index.all? { |t| @pre[p][t].zero? || @post[p][t].zero? } }
    sm = ordinary &&
      inputs.each_index.all? { |t| inputs[t].size == 1 && @places.each_index.count { |p| @post[p][t] > 0 } == 1 }
    mg = ordinary &&
      outputs.each_index.all? { |p|
        outputs[p].size == 1 && @transitions.each_index.count { |t| @post[p][t] > 0 } == 1
      }
    fc = ordinary && outputs.all? { |a| a.all? { |t| a.size == 1 || inputs[t].size == 1 } }
    efc = ordinary && outputs.all? { |a| outputs.all? { |b| (a & b).empty? || a == b } }
    [
      ["ordinary", ordinary],
      ["pure", pure],
      ["state machine", sm],
      ["marked graph", mg],
      ["free choice", fc],
      ["extended free choice", efc]
    ].each { |name, v| puts("#{name}: #{yn(v)}") }
    verdict = !fc ? "not applicable" : @places.size > 12 ? "too many places" : "holds"
    if fc && @places.size <= 12
      traps = sets(true)
      sets(false).each do |s|
        unless traps.any? { |q| q & s == q && @current.each_index.any? { |p| @current[p] > 0 && q & (1 << p) != 0 } }
          verdict = "fails at " + set_text(s)
          break
        end
      end
    end

    puts("commoner: " + verdict)
  end

  def workflow(limit)
    source = @places.each_index.select { |p| @transitions.each_index.all? { |t| @post[p][t].zero? } }
    sink = @places.each_index.select { |p| @transitions.each_index.all? { |t| @pre[p][t].zero? } }
    if source.size != 1
      puts("workflow: no (#{source.size} source places)")
      return
    end

    if sink.size != 1
      puts("workflow: no (#{sink.size} sink places)")
      return
    end

    i = source[0]
    o = sink[0]
    n = @places.size
    names = @places + @transitions
    adj = Array.new(names.size) { [] }
    rev = Array.new(names.size) { [] }
    @places.each_index { |p|
      @transitions.each_index { |t|
        if @pre[p][t] > 0
          adj[p] << n + t
          rev[n + t] << p
        end

        if @post[p][t] > 0
          adj[n + t] << p
          rev[p] << n + t
        end
      }
    }
    f = reachable(adj, i)
    b = reachable(rev, o)
    names.each_index { |v|
      unless f[v] && b[v]
        puts("workflow: no (#{names[v]} is not on a path from #{@places[i]} to #{@places[o]})")
        return
      end
    }
    puts("workflow: source #{@places[i]} sink #{@places[o]}")
    start = Array.new(n, 0)
    start[i] = 1
    goal = Array.new(n, 0)
    goal[o] = 1
    g = graph(start, limit)
    if g[:aborted]
      puts("reachability graph limit #{limit} exceeded")
      return
    end

    goal_index = g[:states].index(goal)
    rev = Array.new(g[:states].size) { [] }
    g[:edges].each_with_index { |e, u| e.each { |_, v| rev[v] << u } }
    option = goal_index && reachable(rev, goal_index).all?
    proper = g[:states].all? { |m| m[o] < 1 || m == goal }
    live = @transitions.each_index.all? { |t| g[:edges].any? { |e| e.any? { |u, _| t == u } } }
    puts(
      "option to complete: #{yn(option)}",
      "proper completion: #{yn(proper)}",
      "no dead transitions: #{yn(live)}",
      "sound: #{yn(option && proper && live)}"
    )
  end

  ARITY = {
    "MARKING" => 0,
    "RESET" => 0,
    "SET" => 2,
    "ENABLED" => 0,
    "FIRE" => -1,
    "UNDO" => 1,
    "SIMULATE" => 3,
    "CONFLICTS" => 0,
    "REACH" => 1,
    "GRAPH" => 1,
    "COVER" => 1,
    "PATH" => 2,
    "INCIDENCE" => 0,
    "PINV" => 0,
    "TINV" => 0,
    "SIPHONS" => 0,
    "TRAPS" => 0,
    "CLASSIFY" => 0,
    "WORKFLOW" => 1,
    "SHOW" => 0
  }.freeze
  def execute(words)
    cmd, *args = words
    raise "unknown command #{cmd}" unless ARITY.key?(cmd)
    raise "wrong number of arguments" unless ARITY[cmd] < 0 ? !args.empty? : args.size == ARITY[cmd]
    if %w[REACH GRAPH COVER PATH WORKFLOW].include?(cmd)
      limit = number(args[0], 1, 2000)
      raise "invalid limit #{args[0]}" unless limit
    end

    case cmd
    when "MARKING"
      puts("marking #{mark(@current)}")
    when "RESET"
      @current = @initial.dup
      @history = []
      puts("marking #{mark(@current)}")
    when "SET"
      p = @places.index(args[0])
      raise "unknown place #{args[0]}" unless p
      v = number(args[1], 0, 999)
      raise "invalid tokens #{args[1]}" unless v
      raise "tokens exceed capacity of #{args[0]}" if @capacity[p] > 0 && v > @capacity[p]
      @current = @current.dup
      @current[p] = v
      @history = []
      puts("marking #{mark(@current)}")
    when "ENABLED"
      puts("enabled: " + listing(names(enabled(@current))))
    when "FIRE"
      ts = args.map { |name| @transitions.index(name) || (raise("unknown transition #{name}")) }
      ts.each_with_index { |t, i|
        if (why = reason(@current, t))
          puts("step #{i + 1}: #{args[i]} not enabled (#{why}) at #{mark(@current)}")
          return
        end

        commit(t)
      }
      puts("fired #{ts.size} -> #{mark(@current)}")
    when "UNDO"
      k = number(args[0], 1, 1000)
      raise "invalid count #{args[0]}" unless k
      raise "cannot undo #{k}: history size #{@history.size}" if k > @history.size
      @current = @history[-k]
      @history.pop(k)
      puts("marking #{mark(@current)}")
    when "SIMULATE"
      steps = number(args[0], 1, 1000)
      x = number(args[1], 1, 2147483646)
      raise "invalid steps #{args[0]}" unless steps
      raise "invalid seed #{args[1]}" unless x
      raise "invalid mode #{args[2]}" unless %w[PRIORITY RANDOM].include?(args[2])
      counts = Array.new(@transitions.size, 0)
      done = 0
      while done < steps
        e = enabled(@current)
        if e.empty?
          puts("dead (steps=#{done})")
          break
        end

        if args[2] == "RANDOM"
          x = x * 48271 % 2147483647
          t = e[x % e.size]
        else
          t = e.max_by { |u| [@priority[u], -u] }
        end

        commit(t)
        counts[t] += 1
        done += 1
        puts("step #{done}: #{@transitions[t]} -> #{mark(@current)}")
      end

      puts("completed (steps=#{steps})") if done == steps
      puts("counts: " + @transitions.each_index.map { |t| "#{@transitions[t]}=#{counts[t]}" }.join(" "))
    when "CONFLICTS"
      structural = []
      effective = []
      @transitions.each_index { |u|
        ((u + 1)...@transitions.size).each { |v|
          pair = "#{@transitions[u]}/#{@transitions[v]}"
          structural << pair if @places.each_index.any? { |p| @pre[p][u] > 0 && @pre[p][v] > 0 }
          if !reason(@current, u) &&
              !reason(@current, v) &&
              (reason(fire(@current, u), v) || reason(fire(@current, v), u))
            effective << pair
          end
        }
      }
      puts("structural: " + listing(structural), "effective: " + listing(effective))
    when "REACH", "GRAPH"
      reach(limit, cmd == "GRAPH")
    when "COVER"
      cover(limit)
    when "PATH"
      entries = args[1].split(",")
      raise "target needs #{@places.size} entries" unless entries.size == @places.size
      target = entries.map { |s|
        if s == "*"
          [0, -1]
        else
          plus = s.end_with?("+")
          v = number(plus ? s[0...-1] : s, 0, 9999999999)
          raise "invalid target entry #{s}" unless v
          [v, plus ? -1 : v]
        end
      }
      g = graph(@current, limit, target)
      if g[:found]
        k = g[:found]
        sequence = names(path(g, k))
        puts(
          "reached #{mark(g[:states][k])} length=#{sequence.size}" + (sequence.empty? ? "" : ": " + sequence.join(" "))
        )
      elsif g[:aborted]
        puts("search limit #{limit} exceeded")
      else
        puts("unreachable (markings explored: #{g[:states].size})")
      end

    when "INCIDENCE"
      rows = [[""] + @transitions] +
        @places.each_index.map { |p|
          [@places[p]] + @transitions.each_index.map { |t| (@post[p][t] - @pre[p][t]).to_s }
        }
      widths = rows.transpose.map { |col| col.map(&:size).max }
      rows.each { |r|
        puts(r.each_index.map { |i| i.zero? ? r[i].ljust(widths[i]) : r[i].rjust(widths[i]) }.join("  ").rstrip)
      }
    when "PINV", "TINV"
      invariants(cmd == "TINV")
    when "SIPHONS", "TRAPS"
      raise "more than 12 places" if @places.size > 12
      values = sets(cmd == "TRAPS")
      puts("minimal #{cmd == "TRAPS" ? "traps" : "siphons"}: #{values.size}")
      values.each { |s|
        puts("  #{set_text(s)} tokens=#{@current.each_index.sum { |p| s & (1 << p) != 0 ? @current[p] : 0 }}")
      }
    when "CLASSIFY"
      classify
    when "WORKFLOW"
      workflow(limit)
    when "SHOW"
      @places.each_index { |p|
        puts("place #{@places[p]} tokens=#{@initial[p]} capacity=#{@capacity[p].zero? ? "none" : @capacity[p]}")
      }
      @transitions.each_index { |t|
        lists = [@pre, @post, @inhibit].map { |m|
          a = @places.each_index.filter_map { |p| "#{@places[p]}:#{m[p][t]}" if m[p][t] > 0 }
          a.empty? ? "-" : a.join(",")
        }
        puts(
          "transition #{@transitions[t]} priority=#{@priority[t]} pre=#{lists[0]} post=#{lists[1]} inhibit=#{lists[2]}"
        )
      }
    end
  end
end

blocks = STDIN.gets.to_i
blocks.times do
  net = Net.new(STDIN.gets.split[1])
  loop do
    line = STDIN.gets.chomp
    break if line == "END NET"
    begin
      net.define(line.split)
    rescue RuntimeError => e
      puts("error: " + e.message)
    end
  end

  net.summary
  STDIN.gets.to_i.times {
    begin
      net.execute(STDIN.gets.split)
    rescue RuntimeError => e
      puts("error: " + e.message)
    end
  }
end
